module: Editor window "Camera Bookmarks" (Camera menu). Lets you create, copy, paste, go to and delete camera bookmarks (CameraBookmark objects stored in the group returned by editor.getCameraBookmarks()). Adding, deleting and pasting a position go through the editor undo history (editor.history:commitAction).
notes: No utility function exported: the module only exposes editor hooks.
A bookmark is created via worldEditorCppApi.createObject('CameraBookmark') with datablock CameraBookmarkMarker and scale '5 5 5'.
The undo/redo replay functions are local (createBookmarkRedo, deleteBookmarkRedo, setCameraTransformRedo/Undo).

onEditorGui.desc: Draws the "Camera Bookmarks" window: name field + Add button, Copy Location / Paste Location buttons, then the bookmark list with Go To, Copy and Delete. Called every frame by the editor.

onEditorInitialized.desc: Registers the window (500x500) and the "Camera Bookmarks" menu entry in the Camera menu group. Called once at editor initialization.
